title: Accountant package
text: A single Excel file with all CRM data for the year — for preparing the balance sheet (Form No. 1) and the income statement (Form No. 2).
companyHint: Name, TIN (INN) and tax regime are taken from

contents.c1: Notes: company details, how figures are calculated, what is not in the CRM
contents.c2: Summary by Form No. 2 line — for the year and by month
contents.c3: Contracts and payments for the year
contents.c4: Client settlements as of 31.12: receivables and advances received
contents.c5: Expenses with a suggested account (cost of sales / period expenses)
